results.title: Stripe launches modular revenue and finance automation suite for enterprise billing
results.content: Stripe unveiled its new modular revenue and finance automation suite on Wednesday, enabling enterprise CFOs to unify usage-based billing across 45 markets.

results.title: Stripe appoints former cloud infrastructure leader Maya Lin as VP of Global Partner Ecosystem
results.content: Stripe has hired Maya Lin as Vice President of Global Partner Ecosystem to accelerate enterprise B2B adoption and regional systems integrator alliances.

results.title: Stripe expands stablecoin settlement rails to 30 additional countries
results.content: Cross-border merchants using Stripe can now settle transactions in regulated stablecoins across 30 additional countries, cutting settlement times from 3 days to under 10 seconds.

results.title: Stripe reports 38 percent growth in AI-native startup payment volume in Q3 update
results.content: Payment volume from AI-native software companies grew 38 percent quarter-over-quarter on Stripe, driven by seat-plus-token hybrid pricing models.

results.title: Stripe introduces adaptive fraud defense model trained on 120 billion annual transactions
results.content: Stripe Radar's updated foundation model evaluated 120 billion annual transactions to reduce false declines by 19 percent for subscription merchants.

results.title: Stripe partners with global airlines on instant multi-currency refund orchestration
results.content: Five major international carriers adopted Stripe's instant multi-currency refund orchestration API ahead of peak holiday travel.
